_terminalsComment: Each terminal is a puzzle TYPE; every team gets its own words/numbers/wall clues (server/puzzles.js). Types: caesar (phrases), binary (words), reverse/sorted (chains: requires = index), split, morse (words), echo, survivor (words), count, glitch (words), pair, beacons. Order matters for 'requires'.
